notes: audit pass: a file attached while answering the assistant's question now actually reaches the model instead of being stranded in the composer; tool cards left behind by a tab closed mid-run read as interrupted rather than spinning forever and hiding their result; the undo history keeps the state a chat first found a file in, so Revert can no longer put back a half-way version once old records are pruned; a chat that keeps running in the background stays bound to the folder it started in and refuses file tools rather than write into whatever project is open now; open_url takes http(s) only, so a blob: or javascript: URL can no longer be opened on the harness's own origin; the web-search API key moved into the secret store, where the remember-secrets switch and Forget all secrets actually reach it; importing a backup now asks about plugin code expressions the way importing a plugin always did; local storage writes survive a full quota, model-written regexes cannot freeze the tab, and the diff engine has a memory ceiling; plus a round of dead code removed
